editor: visual

The data is from the UN Comtrade Database, accessed from a Tidy Tuesday challenge. The data is over the Lesotho Wool Trade from 2010 to 2024. Our objective is to understand the patterns of the Lesotho Wool Trade.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
require(tidyverse)
require(TSA)

library(readr)
basotho_wool <- read_csv("basotho_wool.csv")

basotho_wool = basotho_wool |>
  select(ref_year, ref_month, net_wgt) |>
  group_by(ref_year, ref_month) |>
  summarise(total_wgt = sum(net_wgt, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ts_wool = basotho_wool |>
  select(total_wgt)

ts_wool = ts(ts_wool)

```

The time series plot is below.

```{r}
plot(ts_wool)
```

The ACF and PACF is below.

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1,2))
acf(ts_wool)
pacf(ts_wool)
```
